waitLabel: Wait until the marked route clears
instructions: Stop in the lower-lane waiting bay before the marked crossing or queue. Choose Wait until the marked route clears, then select a pace control again. Guided approach makes the same required stop. A missed waiting bay offers a free loop.

messages.stop: Waiting bay reached. Keep stopped and choose Wait until the marked route clears.
messages.wrongWait: Stop in the lower-lane waiting bay first. Brake early or use Guided approach; the route cannot clear while the bus is moving.
messages.cleared: The marked route is clear. Select a pace control to continue to the final safe bay.
messages.loop: The waiting bay was passed too quickly. Take the free loop, stop earlier or use Guided approach. No clue or fare is lost.
